Messages.Author: Michael Leslie Hennigar
Messages.Body:
I was playing the other night with my group of usuals, and the following
problem arose at the end. A player slapped down a political card (I
forget which), and it passed. The result being that 3 other players lost
enough blood to be ousted. They happenned to be myself, my prey, and my
predator. Are we all gone? Is any blood awarded to myself, or my
predator? Please leave your thoughts.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <1995Oct31.1...@ac.dal.ca>,


Jyhad rulebook, 18.1:
If a predator is ousted the same turn that his or her prey is, the predator
gets the ante and the victory point, but does not get the six blood points.

So, you are all gone, and your grand-predator (who wasn't ousted), gets
six blood. Each of: your Grandpredator, your predator, and you - get
a victory point (and your respective Preys' antes).
